membership_comparison: Exact JavaScript String.includes with no normalization.
length_semantics: JavaScript UTF-16 String.length, matching the frozen v5 parser contract.
membership_failure_policy: Membership is descriptive and does not invalidate a structurally valid response.
zero_candidate_policy: Rates and mean length are null; the run is uninformative.
interpretation_rules: If all three runs are informative and evidence_membership_rate equals 1 in each, classify NOT_REPRODUCED_STOCHASTICITY_PLAUSIBLE.
If all three runs are informative and evidence_membership_rate is below 1 in each, classify CONSISTENTLY_REPRODUCED.
If all three runs are informative and rates mix 1 and below 1, classify RUN_TO_RUN_VARIABILITY.
If any run is zero-candidate or infrastructure/schema-invalid, report it separately and classify INCOMPLETE_FOR_THREE_RUN_RULE.
